tools.name: list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description:
Discover this connection's currently approved Spaces and effective permissions.

Use the returned space_id explicitly on other tools. Discovery does not
consume monthly MCP writes or require any financial Space to be selected.

tools.name: get_finance_context
tools.title: Get finance context
tools.description:
Read only the OAuth-granted Space's role, usage and implemented tool capabilities. Does not switch or enumerate Spaces, change plans, or initiate billing. Web use is independent of MCP quota; safety throttles remain separate.

Select the destination with space_id from list_spaces and preserve it on retries. Reads may omit it when exactly one approved Space is available. Writes require it for multi-Space or future-Space grants; only fixed single-Space grants permit omission. Read-only: does not consume the monthly MCP write allowance and remains available when it is exhausted. Reads return fresh data; request_id is accepted for compatibility but does not cache the result. Temporary MCP safety limits apply to reads, writes and retries independently of monthly usage. If throttled, wait retry_after_seconds before retrying; preserve request_id and arguments for writes.

tools.description:

Small JPEG/PNG/WebP sources retain exact bytes; larger images and all HEIC/HEIF photos use an explicitly labeled derived preview within the existing 1 MiB result limit. Fine text may require the original private download. PDF receipts use the web reader or get_receipt_download_link; native MCP previews support images only. No URL input or public preview link.

tools.name: start_receipt_reading
tools.title: Start receipt reading
tools.description:
Request one page of reading from a saved transaction's receipt using the configured local extraction approach. Reserves one OCR page and counts one successful MCP write action; retry the same request_id after uncertainty. Existing active/completed canonical jobs are reused. Review the untrusted result before separately editing a transaction; this tool applies no financial values.

Select the destination with space_id from list_spaces and preserve it on retries. Reads may omit it when exactly one approved Space is available. Writes require it for multi-Space or future-Space grants; only fixed single-Space grants permit omission. Uses one MCP write action on success. Retry safety: supply request_id as a fresh UUID for a new operation and reuse that UUID with identical arguments when retrying. A completed retry returns the stored result without another write or usage charge. request_id is required for this tool. Temporary MCP safety limits apply to reads, writes and retries independently of monthly usage. If throttled, wait retry_after_seconds before retrying; preserve request_id and arguments for writes.

tools.name: create_transaction_record
tools.title: Create transaction record
tools.description:
Atomically create income/expense with exact amounts, optional authoritative ledger/account/category IDs, include_in_budget and received reimbursements. Recorded by is the authenticated member; omitted or null attributed_to_user_id defaults payer/contributor to that member, or choose an active member from list_transaction_members. IDs override mutable names; corresponding names may be omitted. Dates require offsets. Includes the full financial response with client_uuid/revision. Only money already received belongs in reimbursements; combined bound is 100 entries. Optional client_uuid replays the original row. Retry with the same request_id and identical arguments for no extra quota; a new request_id is a new metered action even when client_uuid replays an existing row.

tools.name: create_transfer_record
tools.title: Create transfer record
tools.description:
Create an account transfer using exact source amount/fee and destination to_amount/to_currency, authoritative ledger/source/destination IDs and optional client_uuid. IDs override names, which may be omitted when IDs are supplied. Dates require offsets. Different account currencies require the exact received amount and destination currency; exchange_rate must be omitted or 1 and never determines received money. Returns the full row. Reuse request_id with identical arguments for a quota-free completed retry. Reusing client_uuid with a fresh request_id prevents another row but remains a separately metered action.

tools.name: update_transaction_record
tools.title: Update transaction record
tools.description:
Update an explicit financial record using the web's shared rules and optional exact expected_updated_at conflict check. Only supplied fields change; blank tag/remark clears. Transfer currencies, endpoints and exact received legs follow the web's account/currency rules; a source-only amount edit preserves a different-currency received leg and synchronizes an explicit same-currency leg. Transaction type cannot change. Read the record first and review financial/category/ledger changes in the granted Space.

tools.description:
Permanently delete exactly the reviewed financial records. Requires confirmed=true after reviewing IDs/client_uuid/revisions and financial consequences. Stale/changed targets reject the entire batch. Remove linked received reimbursements before deleting their expense. All records succeed together; no missing-ID partial deletion.
